name: Tawang Monastery
description: Largest Buddhist monastery in India and second-largest in the world, founded in 1681 by Merak Lama Lodre Gyatso. Gelug sect complex with 500+ monks, 8m Buddha statue, ancient scriptures, and panoramic valley views. Birthplace association with 6th Dalai Lama; 14th Dalai Lama stayed here in 1959.
facts: Second largest Buddhist monastery in the world
Birthplace of the 6th Dalai Lama nearby

name: Sela Pass
description: High-altitude mountain pass at 4170m on the Tawang-West Kameng border, carrying NH-13. Features Sela Lake (often frozen), prayer flags, snow views, and gateway to Tawang. Sela Tunnel (opened 2024) improves year-round access.
facts: On border of Tawang and West Kameng districts

name: Sangetsar Tso (Madhuri Lake)
description: High-altitude lake (~3708m) formed by 1971 earthquake, with submerged tree trunks. Popularly called Madhuri Lake after Bollywood film Koyla shoot. Located on route to Bum La Pass; requires permit.
facts: Featured in film Koyla with Madhuri Dixit

name: Nuranang Falls (Jang Falls)
description: 100m high curtain waterfall on Nuranang Chu near Jang town, 40km from Tawang. Also called Bong Bong Falls. Site of Bollywood song shoots; nearby hydel plant and war memorial association.
facts: Named in connection with 1962 war local legend

name: Bum La Pass
description: India-China border pass at ~4630m, 37km from Tawang. Site of 1962 battle, BPM point, and limited trade. Requires special Army/DC permit; Indian nationals only. Stark high-altitude landscape.
facts: Indian nationals only with special permit

name: Urgelling Monastery
description: Historic monastery founded ~1489, birthplace of the 6th Dalai Lama Tsangyang Gyatso (born 1683). Smaller Nyingma/Gelug site near Tawang Town with peaceful atmosphere and historical significance.

name: Tawang War Memorial
description: Memorial in Tawang Town honoring Indian soldiers of the 1962 Sino-Indian War. Features exhibits, statues, and views; important for understanding regional military history.

name: Jaswant Garh Memorial
description: War memorial near Nuranang/Jang dedicated to Rifleman Jaswant Singh Rawat, MVC (posthumous), who fought in the 1962 Battle of Nuranang. Maintained by Army; popular stop on Tawang road.

name: Pankang Teng Tso (PT Tso)
description: Scenic high-altitude lake near Tawang, also called PTSO Lake. Frozen in winter; popular for views of snow peaks and rhododendrons. Often combined with other Tawang day trips.

name: Tawang Town
description: District headquarters and main tourist base at ~2669-3000m elevation. Gateway to monastery, lakes, and border areas. Monpa culture, markets, and starting point for regional itineraries.
